description: Source code for a CCSP (Cisco Common Service Platform) component implementing D-Bus communication, parameter get/set, and instance management functions, with integration to Duktape JavaScript engine.

methods.name: ccsp_cosa_module_open
methods.description: Initializes the module, registers functions with Duktape, and sets up CCSP communication.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value from the CCSP data model based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: setStr
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the CCSP data model based on a dot-separated path.

methods.name: getInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for a given object path.

methods.name: addTblObj
methods.description: Adds a table row (object) in the CCSP data model.

methods.name: delTblObj
methods.description: Deletes a table row (object) in the CCSP data model.

methods.name: DmExtGetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Retrieves multiple parameter values under a root object.

methods.name: DmExtSetStrsWithRootObj
methods.description: Sets multiple parameter values under a root object.

methods.name: DmExtGetInstanceIds
methods.description: Retrieves instance IDs for a specified object.
